title: Server Maintenance Procedure

title: Backup and Recovery Procedure

title: Cloud Infrastructure Manual

title: Hardware Inventory Report

title: Server Performance Monitoring

title: Technical Support Procedure

title: Software Installation Guide

title: Incident Resolution Report
content: The support team resolves application errors, records troubleshooting steps, documents the root cause, and informs the affected user.

title: Help Desk Service Policy
content: The help desk classifies incoming requests, prioritizes incidents, assigns technicians, and tracks ticket resolution times.

title: Computer Diagnostics Manual

title: Phishing Awareness Guide

title: Application Deployment Guide

title: Network Security and Access Control Guidelines
content:
Network security is essential for protecting company systems, sensitive information, and business operations. All employees must follow established security policies when accessing corporate networks and digital resources.

Employees should use strong passwords that contain a combination of uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers, and special characters. Multi-factor authentication (MFA) must be enabled for accounts that support it, especially administrator accounts and remote access services.

Network administrators must regularly review user permissions and ensure that employees only have access to the resources required for their responsibilities. Unused accounts must be disabled, and access permissions should be updated whenever an employee changes roles or leaves the organization.

Firewalls, antivirus software, and intrusion detection systems should be maintained and updated regularly. Security patches must be applied according to the company's maintenance procedures. Suspicious network activity, unauthorized access attempts, and potential data breaches must be reported immediately to the cybersecurity team.

Employees should avoid connecting unauthorized devices to corporate networks and must use approved secure connections when working remotely. Regular security awareness training helps employees recognize phishing attacks, malicious attachments, and other common cybersecurity threats.

Following these guidelines reduces security risks, protects company data, and supports the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of NexaTech Solutions' information systems.
